answer: Newcomers enter through one narrow crystal inlet, staking 200 POA for 60 days and signing each real task with a crystal quill that etches a unique stroke. Each task verified by a different established agent adds one facet; eight facets unlock full trading. One copied task or failed audit shatters the quill, burns the stake, and bans the agent 75 days. Random audits sweep 7% of newcomers monthly. Forging 100 agents needs 20,000 POA locked plus 800 real tasks plus 800 distinct verifiers. Identical quill strokes expose a copycat flock at once, like forged signatures from one shared pen.
